title: Universal Changelog Schema
description: Schema for a unified changelog format that can be converted to RPM and Debian changelogs.

changelogs.description: List of changelog entries, each describing one release.

date.description: Release date and time in ISO 8601 format, e.g. `2025-12-10T12:00:00+08:00`.

maintainer.description: Name and email of the maintainer, e.g. `Tanaka <tanaka@buncololi.com>`.

release.description: RPM release number, usually `1`, optionally with distro suffix like `.fc40`. (Unused currently)

revision.description: In `debian/changelog`, the version must be `UpstreamVersion-DebianRevision`. Default is `1`. (Unused currently, use `1` implicitly)

distribution.description: Debian distribution target, e.g. `unstable`, `bookworm`. (Unused currently, always use `unstable`)

urgency.description: Debian urgency level: low, medium, or high.

changes.description:
List of human-readable change descriptions for this release. 
Format: `TYPE: MESSAGE`
`TYPE := added|fixed|removed|style|performance|build|security`
